investigation.conclusion: The updater in AppData\Roaming has no signature, starts at sign-in from the Run key and from a scheduled task, and keeps a connection open to 203.0.113.45 on port 443. No installed program owns it. It behaves like the persistence part of a downloader rather than a real updater.

evidence.text: Not signed; the file was created the same minute as the scheduled task.
Starts at sign-in from HKCU\…\Run as "Contoso Updater".
Process 4388 has an established connection to 203.0.113.45:443.
No installed program lists this folder.

investigation.suggestedAction: Remove completely: end the process, turn off the Run entry and the task, quarantine the file.
openQuestions: Which program downloaded it? The browser history may tell.

hints.subject: VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE
hints.title: Graphics driver
hints.text: 3 problems involve the graphics driver (VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE). Install the latest driver from the graphics card maker (NVIDIA, AMD or Intel); if they started after a driver update, go back to the previous version.

hints.subject: contoso.spell.dll
hints.title: One module in several crashes
hints.text: 4 crashes in 2 different programs happened inside contoso.spell.dll. That points to contoso.spell.dll (or the add-in, overlay, security program or driver it belongs to) rather than to the programs themselves.

hints.title: Shutdowns without a blue screen
hints.text: The computer stopped once without shutting down properly and without a blue screen. That usually means a power cut, a forced restart or the computer freezing completely. If it happens while you use it normally, check the power supply and temperatures.

hints.subject: \Device\Harddisk2\DR3
hints.title: Disk retries
hints.text: Windows retried 6 reads or writes on disk 2. Occasional retries are harmless; many can mean a loose cable, a USB drive without enough power or a disk that is wearing out.

hints.subject: Contoso.Notes
hints.title: Store apps couldn't update for now
hints.text: 4 Store app updates did not finish because the app was open, was already updating or was already current (Contoso.Notes). Windows retries on its own; nothing needs doing.
